notes: SOI must be followed by an APPn, DQT, SOFn/DHT, COM or DRI marker, so a stray FFD8FF does not open (or cut) a carve. Marker segments are walked up to start-of-scan, skipping FF fill bytes, so an EXIF thumbnail's own FFD9 cannot end the file early (and the thumbnail's header is embedded data); the footer search begins at the scan data.
